1. Which 1–3 AI problems or research themes most interest you? This will determine which directions, laboratories, prerequisites, and projects the report emphasizes.
2. What is your primary post-PhD objective: academic research, industrial R&D, entrepreneurship, or applied leadership? This will change how programs are weighted for publication culture, internships, industry links, and placement.
3. What is your current AI-PhD readiness profile, including highest degree and field, grades, key math/CS coursework, research or publications, and substantial AI/software experience? This will determine the reach/match shortlist and the gaps addressed in the 1–2 year plan.

1. Natural language processing and deep learning, especially applied, implementation-heavy AI research and system building.
2. Industrial R&D, while preserving strong research and employability options.
3. I am currently a Computer Science and Technology undergraduate at a prestigious university in Jiangsu. My academic performance is excellent, and I have received school scholarships for two consecutive years; my exact GPA is not specified. I mainly prepare through self-directed coding, online learning, technical blogs, and GitHub, using tools such as PyCharm and VS Code extensively. Specific math/CS courses, research experience, publications, and major AI/software projects are not specified.
